```{r setup, include=FALSE}
LOG <- "log.txt"; unlink(LOG)
x <- 5; y <- c(1.23,2.5)
old <- knitr::knit_hooks$get("evaluate.inline")
knitr::knit_hooks$set(evaluate.inline = function(code, envir) {
  cat(sprintf("[%s] <<%s>> input=%s opts_label=%s lines=%s\n", "hook", code,
   tryCatch(knitr::current_input(), error=function(e) "ERR"),
   tryCatch(knitr::opts_current$get("label"), error=function(e) "ERR"),
   tryCatch(paste(deparse(knitr:::current_lines()), collapse=""), error=function(e) paste("ERR", conditionMessage(e)))),
   file = LOG, append = TRUE)
  old(code, envir)
})
```

First `r x` and `r round(mean(y), 1)` here.
